tests.cmd: render tmpl → host=api01 port=8080 role=canary cost=$5

tests.name: softmiss_gate

weaknesses.title: ENV SET is process-local — multi-tick agents cannot seed expand without plate rehydrate
weaknesses.detail: Each cubalc run is a new process. ENV SET in setvar is gone on next render unless agent rehydrates from durable KEY=VAL plate via EACH LINE ENV SET. No ENV export plate or session env.
weaknesses.repro: run setenv; separate run expand sees empty + MISS

weaknesses.title: Naive SPLIT first field loses KEY=VAL values that contain =
weaknesses.detail: DSN=user=u;pass=p with NTH 1 yields only user. Must DROP 1 + JOINLINES = or LOOKUP bag key. No first-sep peel helper.

weaknesses.title: Unset keys expand to empty without hard fail; only SUBSTENV_MISS counter
weaknesses.detail: gone=${NOPE}end → gone=end with MISS=1 OK=1. Agents must gate on MISS or corrupt configs ship empty values.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits trailing NL; VAL/META glue on cat -A
weaknesses.detail: gone=end glued to meta n; VARS last line ROLE=canary without $. Recurring plate hygiene footgun.
weaknesses.repro: cat -A VAL META after expand softmiss

weaknesses.title: No SUBSTENV on path / file-in expand primitive
weaknesses.detail: Agents must READ then SUBSTENV then WRITE. No SUBSTENVFILE path. Race and NL handling on agent.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens gates
Env vs program var precedence only lightly documented
weaknesses.detail: Proof says env first then vars; agents may shadow host ENV with LET unintentionally.
weaknesses.repro: LET FOO + ENV FOO both set

weaknesses.title: KVFILESET create-on-miss invents VARS plate path typos
weaknesses.detail: Same class as KVFILEINC create footgun for durable vars.

workarounds: Always durable KEY=VAL plate + rehydrate before SUBSTENV across ticks
Peel values with DROP 1 + JOINLINES = or LOOKUP key (not NTH 1 alone)
Gate on SUBSTENV_MISS > 0 before writing configs
Prefer ${NAME} braced form for adjacent punctuation
language_gaps: Session or plate-backed ENV export/import primitive
SUBSTENV hard-fail mode on MISS (or REQUIRE MISS)
First-sep peel helper (KEY rest-of-line after first =)
Document env-over-var SUBSTENV precedence in help
issues_faced: First draft setenv-only failed multi-tick render (empty expand) — fixed with VARS rehydrate
DSN embedded = broke NTH1 rehydrate — fixed DROP+JOINLINES
